subject: CS350
filterSummary: Successfully selected 4 of 5 English videos and 3 of 5 Arabic videos. The topics 'Multilevel Relations and Polyinstantiation' (en, ar) and 'Discretionary Access Control' (ar) had no eligible candidates due to a lack of specific, relevant content that passed the quality gates. The selected videos are highly relevant, from reputable channels, and have strong view counts, indicating peer validation.

coverage.note: All candidates failed hard gates. One was too short (<120s), the other was too general and failed the relevance gate (<6).
